scenes: Dhaka. One of the world’s densest cities, where heat fills tin-roofed homes.
Heat illness cost Bangladesh two hundred and fifty million workdays in 2024.
Dhaka North appointed Asia’s first chief heat officer.
Cooler roofs and paid rest protect both health and income.
